description: This file defines React context and hooks for managing card detail state, including adding and deleting blocks within a card in a web application.

classes.name: CardDetailContextType
classes.description: Type defining the context value for card detail, including card data, last added block info, and methods to add or delete blocks.

classes.name: CardDetailProps
classes.description: Type for the props accepted by the CardDetailProvider component, including the card data and children elements.

methods.name: useCardDetailContext
methods.description: Custom hook to access the CardDetailContext, throws error if context is not available.

methods.name: CardDetailProvider
methods.description: React component that provides card detail context, manages adding and deleting blocks within a card.
